{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./sim3c.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --time=14-00:00:00   -> -t 14d
#   --ntasks=1           -> -n 1
#   --cpus-per-task=10   -> -c 10
#   --gres=gpu:1         -> -g 1
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 10 -g 1 -t 14d --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name=sim3c not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --output/--error used %j expansion (jobid) which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: log filenames may not be unique unless you add uniqueness.

  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=pascal-deep.p not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible GPU resources; you are not forcing the pascal-deep.p partition.

  module load CUDA/10.0.130

  . /home/fatimamh/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
  conda activate kis

  flux run -n 1 -c 10 -g 1 python /hits/basement/nlp/fatimamh/codes/keep_it_simple/run_keep_it_simple.py \
    -d /hits/basement/nlp/fatimamh/outputs/hipo/exp03/wiki_mono_test-rand_200-cos-edge-add_f=0.0_b=1.0_s=0.5
fi
"
}
